findings.title: Admisión con presupuesto ficticio y permanencia forzada no garantizada
findings.mechanism: Capital inválido se sustituía por13; vectores sin igual longitud podían provocar panic; NaN alcanzaba ranking; bono1e6 no garantizaba inclusión; forced IDs repetidos ampliaban cupo; faltaban min_notional y max_leverage.
reproductions: forced member displaced by granularity score
min_notional1000 ignored despite low lot value
repairs: deduplicated forced members with lexicographic priority
minimum required notional and lower leverage limit
error if selected ID is not representable by bitmap64
limits: K=sqrt(capital)/2 retained
dual historical scores retained explicitly
forced membership is not new-exposure authorization
wrapper empty loses error reason
no position lifecycle management
no composite snapshot epoch
not a full margin/order feasibility solver
findings.closure: Stable instrument snapshot; separate observation, mandatory position management and admission; calibrated objective and final feasible quantities.

findings.title: Retorno neto diario confundido con volatilidad espectral
findings.mechanism: abs(priceChangePercent24h) loses path variation. x*exp(-x/15) encodes a fixed15-percent preference; historical scalp/swing recipes are not integration over temporal scales. Leverage penalty reuses band and decreases at large x.
reproductions: same zero endpoint return for constant and oscillating path; selector omits both
band peak15/e yields penalty max~1.104; penalty at100 is1
limits: penalty diagnostic reproduces expression rather than private network function
no economic optimality or quantum advantage established
no new continuous portfolio engine
findings.closure: Separate return, realized variation, liquidity and cost estimands; define scale measure, uncertainty and independent validation.

findings.title: Feed inválido fabrica universo; duplicados y empates alteran slots
findings.mechanism: Empty, malformed or wholly invalid feed returned canonical10 and was published. Duplicate symbols occupied multiple slots; equal scores depended on input order.
reproductions: tie order changes with reversed feed
repairs: deduplicate identical observations; reject conflicting observations
ln_1p and bounded band evaluated first
empty/error network selection does not replace prior universe
limits: no HTTP integration test
last universe has no freshness/expiry
public sync can still overwrite universe directly
three-character/ASCII filter, stablecoins, top10 and15-percent band retained
no operative caller found in local static search
findings.closure: Versioned publication and availability state, explicit policy constraints, common pure parser used by actual consumer.

findings.title: Ranking mutable y cache de IDs inicial pueden cambiar atribución
findings.mechanism: Host startup map has precedence for known symbols while try_symbol/try_spec interpret ID using current ordered universe. [A,B]->[C,A] leaves cached A0 but dynamic ID0 means C.
reproductions: real registry/universe lookups plus equivalent cached host map disagree after rotation
limits: not a live position or full event-loop simulation
no financial loss attribution
changing lookup alone does not migrate positions/features
findings.closure: Stable IDs independent of ranking, versioned bindings and lifecycle for delayed fills; migration/rotation replay with all consumers.

findings.title: validate_order acepta NaN y su decimal rounding aumenta cantidad
findings.mechanism: Inequalities fail to reject NaN. round(-log10(step)) is not the precision of a general decimal lot increment; second rounding can exceed request or leave lattice.
reproductions: step.025 raw.09 ->.08 not integer lot count
limits: no operational caller located in crates/src
no exchange order submitted
findings.closure: Decimal/integer lot contract, finite/range validation, monotone round-down and final serialization tests; not another arbitrary epsilon.

findings.title: Políticas divergentes y tests duplicados no protegen filtro real
findings.mechanism: Environment-dependent volume thresholds differ across selectors; testnet_blacklist applies unconditionally; tests copy incomplete closure; truncate precedes usable ExchangeInfo validation; fees/leverage/filter defaults not observed.
limits: no current exchange listing/status assertion
not all safety filters are arbitrary
no end-to-end HTTP test
findings.closure: Common pure parsing/eligibility logic, explicit versioned policies, validated metadata before truncation and observed/configured/unknown provenance.

findings.title: Universo y specs sin epoch conjunto; refresco condicionado a cambio de lista
findings.mechanism: List and metadata publication separate, specs updated only under changed-list gate, persistence/reconnect errors discarded. Registry read-clone-store can lose concurrent updates.
limits: no concurrency fault injection or operational disruption
individual ArcSwap safety does not certify composite consistency
findings.closure: Versioned snapshot and ack/retry protocol, metadata refresh independent of ranking, stable IDs, durable generation and observable failures.
